- Streaming UTF-8 now preserves decoder state across chunks and retains lone trailing CR characters.
- Pagination uses exclusive cursors and continues through short or empty filtered pages, with repeated-cursor and page-budget failures.
- Dependency aliases resolve transitively, and build ordering deduplicates real nodes while detecting alias and dependency cycles.
- Layered configuration preserves intentional falsy values, ignores `undefined` overrides, and deep-clones mutable values.
